subject: phy
title: Dynamics
subtitle: Dynamics with model-based reasoning, equations, and exam application.
concept: Dynamics explains why motion changes by linking force to acceleration. Newton laws provide the conceptual and mathematical framework for this link.
Resultant force determines acceleration direction and magnitude through F = ma. Balanced forces produce zero acceleration, not necessarily zero velocity.
Momentum ideas extend dynamics to collisions and explosions, where conservation principles simplify complex interactions.
